promotions.title: ZA Card PowerDraw Promotion

promotions.description: ZA Card users can participate in PowerDraw when making eligible transactions, with a chance to win up to a 200% rebate on their purchases. The promotion includes opportunities to earn MillionTix for a chance to share in a HKD 1 million prize pool.

promotions.title: HKD 1,000 Spending Rebate for New Customers

promotions.description: New customers who open an account using invitation code ZADT88 and complete specified requirements can earn a HKD 1,000 spending rebate. This promotion gives new users significant value when they start using ZA Bank services.

best_for.detail: Lifetime commission-free trading on Hong Kong stocks with HKD 15 platform fee per order. Beats ZA Bank (HKD 18 platform fee despite $0 commission) and PADB (charges brokerage commission per trade).
best_for.why_others_lose: ZA Bank charges HKD 18 platform fee per order (despite $0 commission), making total cost HKD 18/order. PADB charges brokerage commission per HK trade. EleBank's HKD 15 total cost is the lowest among all banks.

best_for.detail: $0 brokerage commission + USD 0.0099/share platform fee (min USD 1.99/order). EleBank ties with USD 0.0049/share commission (min $0.99) + USD 0.005/share platform (min $1.00) = USD 0.0099/share, min USD 1.99/order total cost.
best_for.why_others_lose: EleBank effectively ties ZA Bank for US stocks (both min USD 1.99/order; USD 0.0099/share total). ZA Bank chosen as default winner for simpler $0-commission structure. PADB charges USD 0.012/share commission with zero platform fee - more expensive than ZA Bank/EleBank at higher share volumes.

best_for.detail: Zero platform fee for new crypto traders for 90 days with 24/7 trading capability directly with HKD or USD deposits.
best_for.why_others_lose: No other virtual bank in the dataset currently offers a comparable crypto trading promotion with fee waivers or platform details.

best_for.detail: Up to 2% Unlimited CashBack on all spending with no cap, plus special promotions offering 20% cash rebate across 5 merchants.
best_for.why_others_lose: ZA Bank offers StockBack (stock rewards instead of cash) with up to 1.5% rebates on eligible transactions, which is lower than Mox Bank's 2% Unlimited CashBack rate with no cap.

best_for.detail: New customers can earn up to HKD 2,150 cash bonus with code XM1500MOX, plus access to 2% Unlimited CashBack.
best_for.why_others_lose: ZA Bank offers HKD 1,000 spending rebate for new customers with invitation code ZADT88, which is lower than Mox Bank's HKD 2,150 cash bonus.

best_for.detail: Travel Pick & Go Insurance with FREE add-on coverage plus Trip.com exclusive offer with up to 8% off and up to HKD 1,700 cash rewards.
best_for.why_others_lose: EleBank offers up to HKD 800 cash rebate on flight bookings, which is lower than Mox Bank's combined benefits of free insurance add-ons and Trip.com rewards worth up to HKD 1,700.

best_for.detail: Tax Season Instant Loan with APR as low as 1.18% plus up to HKD 10,888 cash reward, valid until 2026-04-30.
best_for.why_others_lose: WeLab Bank and Ant Bank offer personal loans but don't specify an APR as low as Mox Bank's 1.18%. Additionally, Mox Bank offers a substantial cash reward up to HKD 10,888.

best_for.detail: WeLab Global Wallet provides access to 'best foreign exchange rates in town' as a permanent feature.
best_for.why_others_lose: While other banks offer multi-currency accounts, only WeLab Bank explicitly promotes having the 'best exchange rates in town' as a permanent feature. Fusion Bank offers 24-hour FX service but doesn't claim superior rates. ZA Bank and Ant Bank offer multi-currency accounts without specific FX rate advantages.

best_for.detail: 0% subscription fees on ALL funds with no cap until July 31, 2026.
best_for.why_others_lose: Mox Bank offers 0% fund subscription fee but only until June 30, 2026 (one month earlier than ZA Bank). WeLab Bank offers $0 subscription and switching fees but only for 'featured funds' not ALL funds. PADB offers zero fees only for money market funds, not for all fund types.

best_for.detail: Earn up to HKD 90,000 for referring friends to open accounts, running from March 26 to May 27, 2026.
best_for.why_others_lose: WeLab Bank's referral program offers HKD 800 per successful personal loan referral, which is significantly lower than ZA Bank's potential HKD 90,000 total referral earnings.

ZA Bank.focus: Stock trading, crypto, high-value referrals, zero-fee fund investments
strengths: Zero commission stock trading ($0 brokerage + USD 0.0099/share platform fee for US stocks)
Crypto trading with zero platform fee for 90 days
High-value referral program (up to HKD 90,000)
Zero subscription fees on ALL funds until July 31, 2026
ZA Bank.expiring_alert: Fund subscription fee promotion (0% on ALL funds) ends July 31, 2026. Referral program with high rewards (up to HKD 90,000) ends May 27, 2026.

EleBank.focus: Low-cost stock trading, flight rebates, fast account opening
strengths: Lowest HK stock trading cost (lifetime commission-free + HKD 15 platform fee per order)
Competitive US stock trading (USD 1.99 minimum per order)
Up to HKD 800 cash rebate on flight bookings
EleBank.expiring_alert: Travel with Visa Card Flight Rebate promotion (up to HKD 800) may end soon (promotion periods vary by airline).
EleBank.vs_za_pros: HK stock total cost HKD 15/order vs ZA Bank's HKD 18/order — saves HKD 3 per trade. US stock costs effectively tie with ZA Bank (both min USD 1.99/order).
EleBank.vs_za_cons: No cryptocurrency trading options. Fewer promotional offers overall compared to ZA Bank. No significant fund investment promotions like ZA Bank's 0% subscription fee on ALL funds.

Mox Bank.focus: Cashback rewards, promotional variety, low-APR loans, travel benefits
strengths: Up to 2% Unlimited CashBack on all spending with no cap
Tax Season Instant Loan with APR as low as 1.18% plus up to HKD 10,888 cash reward
New customer welcome offers up to HKD 2,150
Comprehensive travel benefits with Trip.com partnership
Mox Bank.expiring_alert: Tax Season Instant Loan promotion with 1.18% APR ends April 30, 2026 (tomorrow). Multiple time-limited promotions ending April 30, 2026.
Mox Bank.vs_za_pros: Higher unlimited cashback rate (2% vs ZA Bank's stock rewards up to 1.5%). More promotional variety with 24 time-limited offers vs ZA Bank's 15. Better travel partnerships with Trip.com exclusive discounts.
Mox Bank.vs_za_cons: No zero-fee stock trading platform (ZA Bank offers $0 commission stock trading). No crypto trading platform (ZA Bank offers zero platform fee for 90 days).

WeLab Bank.focus: FX rates, zero-fee fund features, loan referrals
strengths: Best foreign exchange rates through WeLab Global Wallet
Zero subscription and switching fees for featured funds
Personal loan referral program (HKD 800 per referral)
WeLab Bank.expiring_alert: Personal loan referral campaign (HKD 800 per referral) ends June 30, 2026.
WeLab Bank.vs_za_pros: Claims to offer 'best exchange rates in town' as a permanent feature (ZA Bank doesn't highlight competitive FX rates).
WeLab Bank.vs_za_cons: Zero-fee funds limited to featured funds only, while ZA Bank offers 0% subscription fees on ALL funds. Lower referral rewards (HKD 800 per loan referral) compared to ZA Bank (up to HKD 90,000 total).

strengths: Enhanced interest rates for time deposits (Flash Monday and Foreign Exchange Time Deposit offers)
Multi-currency transfers in HKD, CNY and USD
24-hour foreign exchange service
Fusion Bank.expiring_alert: Three time-limited promotions (Foreign Exchange Time Deposit, Flash Monday High-Interest Time Deposit, and Savings Interest Plus) are marked as 'Limited time offer' without specific end dates.
Fusion Bank.vs_za_pros: Special time deposit interest rate promotions not offered by ZA Bank.
Fusion Bank.vs_za_cons: No stock or crypto trading platforms (ZA Bank offers both). No fund investment platform with comparable fee structure to ZA Bank's 0% subscription fees on ALL funds.

PADB.focus: Varied fund subscription fees, US stock extended hours, low investment thresholds
strengths: Discounted fund subscription fees (0% for money market funds, 0.5% for bond funds, 1% for mixed and equity funds)
US stock trading with extended hours (16 hours daily)
Low minimum investment threshold for money market funds (from just $20 USD/HK$100)
PADB.vs_za_pros: Extended US stock trading hours (16 hours daily including pre-market and after-hours). Lower minimum investment threshold for money market funds.
PADB.vs_za_cons: Higher stock trading costs than ZA Bank (charges brokerage commission for HK stocks; USD 0.012/share for US stocks vs ZA's USD 0.0099/share). Only offers 0% subscription fee for money market funds, while ZA Bank offers 0% on ALL funds.

Ant Bank.focus: SME loans, multi-currency accounts, investment platform
strengths: SME Loan Cash Rebate up to HK$100,000 on first drawdown
Multi-currency savings account supporting HKD, RMB, and USD
New investment fund platform with insurance products
Ant Bank.expiring_alert: SME Loan Cash Rebate Promotion (up to HK$100,000) is a limited time offer with no specific end date.
Ant Bank.vs_za_pros: Specialized in SME loan products with high cash rebate (up to HK$100,000) which ZA Bank doesn't prominently feature.
Ant Bank.vs_za_cons: No competitive stock trading platform (ZA Bank offers zero commission trading). No fund investment fee waiver comparable to ZA Bank's 0% subscription fees on ALL funds.

livi bank.focus: Preferential savings rates, insurance products, BOC card benefits
strengths: Preferential savings rate promotion with no minimum deposit
Comprehensive insurance offerings (travel, home, pet care)
Business banking and SME financing solutions
livi bank.expiring_alert: liviSave Preferential Savings Rate Promotion has no specified end date.
livi bank.vs_za_pros: More diverse insurance product offerings including specialized pet care insurance. Business banking solutions specifically for SMEs.
livi bank.vs_za_cons: No stock trading platform (ZA Bank offers zero commission trading). No fund investment platform with competitive fee structure. No crypto trading options like ZA Bank offers.
